plan.goal: Compute the geometric centroid of the four existing Walmart locations to establish a central candidate point with approximately equal distances to all sites.
plan.notes: CRS is EPSG:32111. Calculate the mean center of the 4 point features.

plan.goal: Generate a 300-meter buffer zone around the road network to delineate areas suitable for road proximity.
plan.notes: Buffer distance is exactly 300 meters. CRS units are in meters.

plan.goal: Determine the final proposed store location by selecting a point within the 300-meter road buffer that is closest to the computed centroid.
plan.notes: If the centroid intersects the buffer, retain it. If outside, snap or project it to the nearest road segment within the 300m zone. Output a single point shapefile.

plan.goal: Render a map image displaying the proposed location alongside the four existing Walmart locations to fulfill the visualization request.
plan.notes: Create a static map combining the new proposed point and existing sites. Save as PNG.
